# Protocol spec

<!-- Generated by packages/protocol/src/spec.test.ts. Don't edit this file. Regenerate: bun --bun vitest run -u packages/protocol -->

This page lists the frames that the server and its clients exchange, for protocol version 1. A test generates it from the schemas in [`packages/protocol/src`](https://github.com/jcore9/Aphelion/tree/main/packages/protocol/src) and fails when this page is out of date. [The client protocol](protocol.md) explains replay, resync and command ids.

## Envelope

Every frame is one JSON object with these fields. A frame with a field that its type doesn't list is rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v` | `1` | yes | The protocol version. |
| `type` | `"command"` or `"resume"` or `"result"` or `"event"` or `"resync"` or `"error"` | yes | The frame type. |

## Frames a client sends

### `command` frame

Asks the server to run a command.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`CommandId`](#commandid) | yes | The client picks it. A retry sends the same id. |
| `name` | `"ping"` | yes | The command to run. |
| `payload` | object | yes | The command's input. |

### `resume` frame

Asks for the events the client missed.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | [`Cursor`](#cursor) or `null` | yes | The client's position, or null when it has none. |

## Frames the server sends

### `result` frame

Answers a command that succeeded.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`CommandId`](#commandid) | yes | The id of the command this frame answers. |
| `name` | `"ping"` | yes | The command that ran. |
| `result` | object | yes | The command's output. |

### `event` frame

Tells every client that something happened.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `seq` | integer from 1 to 9,007,199,254,740,991 (the largest safe integer) | yes | The event's position in the stream. |
| `name` | `"notice"` or `"bot.event"` | yes | The kind of event. |
| `payload` | object | yes | What happened. |

### `resync` frame

Tells a client that it can't catch up.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | [`Cursor`](#cursor) | yes | Where the client continues after it reloads. |

### `error` frame

Rejects a frame.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `"malformed"` or `"unsupported-version"` | yes | Why the frame was rejected. |
| `message` | string | yes | Fixed text that is safe to log. |
| `id` | [`CommandId`](#commandid) | no | The rejected command's id, when it had a valid one. |

## Commands

A `command` frame carries a command's `payload`, and the `result` frame that answers it carries the command's `result`.

### `ping` command

`payload` has no fields, so it is `{}`.

`result` has no fields, so it is `{}`.

## Events

An `event` frame carries the event's `payload`.

### `notice` event

A message for every client to show.

`payload` has these fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | string | yes | Text for a person to read. |

### `bot.event` event

One event of one bot, in the order the server saved it.

`payload` has these fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bot` | string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$` | yes | The bot the event belongs to. |
| `turn` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$` or `null` | yes | The turn the event belongs to. It is `null` for an `error` outside a turn. |
| `format` | integer from 1 to 9,007,199,254,740,991 (the largest safe integer) | yes | The format version of the saved event. It is 1 today, and a change to an event's shape raises it. |
| `event` | [`BotEvent`](#botevent) | yes | What happened. |

## Shared types

### `CommandId`

Names one command. The client picks it, and a retry sends the same id.

It is a string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$`.

### `Cursor`

A position in an event stream.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stream` | [`StreamId`](#streamid) | yes | The stream that the position is in. |
| `seq` | integer from 0 to 9,007,199,254,740,991 (the largest safe integer) | yes | The position of the last event the client has seen. |

### `StreamId`

Names one event stream. It is not the server ID: the server gives the stream a new ID when it restores a backup, so a cursor from before the restore gets `resync`.

It is a string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$`.

### `BotTextDelta`

A piece of the bot's reply.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"text.delta"` | yes | The kind of event. |
| `text` | string | yes | The next piece of the bot's reply. It is 1 byte to 16 KiB of UTF-8. |

### `BotToolStart`

The bot started to use a tool.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"tool.start"` | yes | The kind of event. |
| `call` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$` | yes | The id of the tool call, for the matching `tool.end`. |
| `tool` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$` | yes | The tool's name. |
| `kind` | `"file.read"` or `"file.write"` or `"shell"` or `"web"` or `"other"` | yes | What the tool does, in terms that don't depend on the vendor. |

### `BotToolEnd`

A tool call ended.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"tool.end"` | yes | The kind of event. |
| `call` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$` | yes | The id of the tool call that ended. |
| `outcome` | `"ok"` or `"error"` or `"denied"` or `"cancelled"` | yes | How the call ended. |

### `BotUsage`

What a turn used.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"usage"` | yes | The kind of event. |
| `inputTokens` | integer from 0 to 9,007,199,254,740,991 (the largest safe integer) | yes | Tokens the bot read. |
| `outputTokens` | integer from 0 to 9,007,199,254,740,991 (the largest safe integer) | yes | Tokens the bot wrote. |
| `cacheReadTokens` | integer from 0 to 9,007,199,254,740,991 (the largest safe integer) | yes | Tokens read from the vendor's cache. |
| `cacheWriteTokens` | integer from 0 to 9,007,199,254,740,991 (the largest safe integer) | yes | Tokens written to the vendor's cache. |
| `costUsd` | number or `null` | yes | The cost in US dollars, or `null` when the vendor has none. |

### `BotError`

Something went wrong with the bot.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"error"` | yes | The kind of event. |
| `code` | `"cli-not-found"` or `"cli-exited"` or `"signed-out"` or `"rate-limited"` or `"vendor"` or `"adapter"` | yes | What went wrong, as a fixed code. |

### `BotTurnEnd`

A turn ended.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"turn.end"` | yes | The kind of event. |
| `reason` | `"completed"` or `"cancelled"` or `"denied"` or `"limit"` or `"refused"` or `"error"` | yes | Why the turn ended. |

### `BotPermissionRequest`

The bot asked whether a tool may run.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"permission.request"` | yes | The kind of event. |
| `request` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$` | yes | The id of the request, for the matching decision. |
| `call` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$` or `null` | yes | The tool call the request is for, or `null`. |
| `tool` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$` | yes | The tool's name. |
| `kind` | `"file.read"` or `"file.write"` or `"shell"` or `"web"` or `"other"` | yes | What the tool does, in terms that don't depend on the vendor. |
| `pathCount` | integer from 0 to 32 | yes | How many paths the tool wants. The paths are never sent. |
| `hasCommand` | boolean | yes | Whether the tool wants to run a command. It is never sent. |

### `BotPermissionDecision`

A permission request was allowed or denied.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"permission.decision"` | yes | The kind of event. |
| `request` | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$` | yes | The id of the request this decision answers. |
| `decision` | `"allow"` or `"deny"` | yes | The answer. |
| `by` | `"rule"` or `"policy"` or `"owner"` or `"default"` | yes | Who decided. |
| `reason` | `"inside-folder"` or `"outside-folder"` or `"web"` or `"shell"` or `"unknown-tool"` or `"cancelled"` or `"turn-ended"` or `"timeout"` or `"shutdown"` or `"no-decider"` or `"invalid-request"` or `"duplicate-request"` or `"invalid-decision"` or `"decider-failed"` | yes | Why, as a fixed code. |

### `BotEvent`

One thing a bot did. The bot's session is not one of them: the server keeps it.

It is a [`BotTextDelta`](#bottextdelta) or [`BotToolStart`](#bottoolstart) or [`BotToolEnd`](#bottoolend) or [`BotUsage`](#botusage) or [`BotError`](#boterror) or [`BotTurnEnd`](#botturnend) or [`BotPermissionRequest`](#botpermissionrequest) or [`BotPermissionDecision`](#botpermissiondecision).

## Error codes

An `error` frame's `code` is one of these. [The client protocol](protocol.md#errors) explains each one.

- `malformed`
- `unsupported-version`

## JSON Schema

[`client-frame.schema.json`](https://github.com/jcore9/Aphelion/blob/main/packages/protocol/client-frame.schema.json) describes the frames a client sends, and [`server-frame.schema.json`](https://github.com/jcore9/Aphelion/blob/main/packages/protocol/server-frame.schema.json) describes the frames the server sends. Both are JSON Schema draft-07, generated by the same test. Use them to check frames, or to generate types, in another language.
